due to this, there are two things to know. the first is that we will be progressively lowering the leverage and OI caps available on papertrade from up to 60 minutes before the window begins, and will not be processing any trades after the upgrade at all until such a time as the "post only" period is over, and we can confirm the books are live once more.

once frozen, a markets oracle price is locked, forever, and will stop updating with the hyperliquid books. traders with positions in such a market are free to close them out at their leisure at the last recorded BBO price before the freeze.

items.author: 0xDeployer
items.new_information: hook按背书价铸造、费用回流篮子，偏离池买入有溢价风险

evidence.quote: deployed MAG7 this evening, the first index on bankr: one token backed by a basket of up to 20 tokens. and on MAG7, the trading fees go to the holders.

every buy, a uniswap v4 hook buys all 7 stocks from their own pools and mints MAG7. every sell burns MAG7 and sells the basket. one transaction either way. the index itself needs no LP, so creators don’t need to provide liquidity to launch one. it’s already in the pools of the tokens it holds. this isn’t possible without uniswap hooks.

the fees: MAG7 charges 0.50% a trade. i set my creator cut to 0, so 0.30% of every buy and sell goes back into the basket for holders, and 0.20% to the protocol. nobody claims anything. it’s released into the basket over 24h, so after every trade each MAG7 is backed by a little more. creators pick a fee of 0.25–1% at launch and it never changes.

the index never market-sells when rebalancing. it runs dutch auctions, offering what it holds too much of at a price that starts good for holders and gets cheaper every minute until someone fills it. anyone can fill. every rebalance gets 48h notice, so holders can leave first.
buying MAG7 on bankr isn’t available in the US or UK.

a note if you’re speculating: MAG7 isn’t priced like a memecoin. its price is the value of the stocks it holds, shown live as "backing" on the bankr trade page. buying on bankr mints new MAG7 at that price, so buys don’t pump it. it moves with the 7 stocks. other pools can trade above or below the backing until arbs close the gap, and buying above it means
paying more than it’s backed by.

evidence.quote: A new Anthropic-written safety bill is circulating on Capitol Hill. Some of its ideas could be reasonable if limited to true frontier companies. As written, however, it will eventually sweep in most of Silicon Valley, damaging the startup ecosystem.

The bill defines the “frontier” as any model trained on 10²⁵ FLOPs — the EU standard from 2023. Biden’s executive order, California’s SB 53, and New York’s RAISE Act used 10²⁶ (ten times more). 10²⁷ is where the frontier actually is today (e.g., GPT-6 Astra).

The definition is also cumulative: it adds FLOPs from fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, or other material modifications. In practice, that captures almost all meaningful post-training — work that is becoming commonplace in the enterprise.
A stale 2023 cutoff favors incumbents who already clear the bar and can absorb the costs. It hobbles the open model ecosystem that threatens Anthropic’s pricing power.

items.summary: Ed Yardeni与Toby Hearst认为，CoreWeave、Oracle等高风险AI借款人债券利差扩大，应会让AI泡沫“泄气”而非破裂；AI公司债抛售引发的避险需求还托住了美债，他们不太认为会引发全面信贷紧缩或衰退。
items.author: IamRamenPanda
items.new_information: 认为信用收紧使AI泡沫泄气而非破裂，且不至于引发全面信贷紧缩

evidence.quote: Ed Yardeni & Toby Hearst • 2026年10月17日

我们比较乐观的看法是，“债券卫士”（Bond Vigilantes）现在在监管 AI 生态系统和配置资本方面做得很好。信贷质量利差正在扩大，以反映 CoreWeave 和 Oracle 等一些风险较高的 AI 相关借款人所发行债券的风险。这些借款人迅速上升的信贷成本应该会使 AI 泡沫“泄气”而非“破裂”。如果一些 AI 相关信贷真的爆发危机，“AI 黑手党”的教父们（以及他们在政府中的保护者）会清理烂摊子。就像《教父 2》里那样，迈克尔·柯里昂（Michael Corleone）有太多利害关系，绝不会让他的兄弟弗雷多（Fredo）搞砸家族生意。

与此同时，AI 公司债市场的暴跌引发了对高质量和安全资产的追捧，这已经阻止了美国国债市场的暴跌。这证实了我们的论点：近期美国国债收益率的上升主要反映了优于预期的经济增长。AI 公司债市场更严格的信贷条件应该会抑制一些 AI 的过度行为。然而，我们怀疑这是否会引发全经济范围的信贷紧缩或经济衰退。我们不认为它会大幅减缓资本支出，因为劳动力和材料短缺，加上公众对数据中心建设的“别在我家后院”（NIMBY）抵制，已经减缓了数据中心的建设速度。
